SELECT e.user_id AS userId, e.name AS name, e.email AS email, d.name AS departmentName, p.name AS parentDepartmentName, jp.name AS jobPositionName, a.role AS role, a.status AS accountStatus, a.must_change_password AS mustChangePassword, e.resigned_at AS resignedAt, e.profile_image_key AS profileImageKey FROM employee e JOIN account a ON a.user_id = e.user_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id AND d.company_id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN department p ON p.department_id = d.parent_id AND p.company_id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN job_position jp ON jp.job_position_id = e.job_position_id AND jp.company_id = e.company_id
ORDER BY e.name ASC, e.user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee e JOIN account a ON a.user_id = e.user_id

SELECT e.user_id AS userId, e.name AS name, e.email AS email, e.department_id AS departmentId, d.name AS departmentName, p.name AS parentDepartmentName, e.job_position_id AS jobPositionId, jp.name AS jobPositionName, a.role AS role, a.status AS accountStatus, a.must_change_password AS mustChangePassword, e.phone AS phone, e.hired_at AS hiredAt, e.resigned_at AS resignedAt, a.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, e.is_system AS isSystem FROM employee e JOIN account a ON a.user_id = e.user_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id AND d.company_id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN department p ON p.department_id = d.parent_id AND p.company_id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN job_position jp ON jp.job_position_id = e.job_position_id AND jp.company_id = e.company_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT g.group_id AS groupId, g.name AS name FROM employee_group_member m JOIN employee_group g ON g.group_id = m.group_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY g.name ASC

SELECT e.major_id AS majorId, mj.name AS majorName, e.degree AS degree, e.school AS school FROM employee_education e JOIN major mj ON mj.major_id = e.major_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.employee_education_id ASC

SELECT c.certificate_id AS certificateId, ct.name AS certificateName, c.acquired_date AS acquiredDate FROM employee_certificate c JOIN certificate ct ON ct.certificate_id = c.certificate_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.employee_certificate_id ASC
